Application Data.NAME: Sweet Delights Bakery
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Sweet St, Suite 100, Dessert City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Delights Bakery specializes in offering a variety of gourmet desserts, including cakes, pastries, and artisanal chocolates. We provide limited alcohol service, featuring a selection of fine wines and dessert cocktails to complement our menu. Our operations focus on delivering high-quality, handcrafted sweets made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. We maintain a clean and safe environment, adhering to all local health regulations and guidelines. Our staff is trained in food safety and responsible alcohol service, ensuring a delightful and safe experience for our customers. We also conduct regular maintenance on our equipment and have comprehensive risk management strategies in place.
